explanation: F_k(n) (maxLinesAtLeast) and f_k(n) (maxLinesExactly) are the maximum numbers of determined lines with ≥ k, respectively exactly k, of n points in ℝ², matching erdosproblems.com/669; the counts are bounded, so the sSup is attained. Question: determine lim F_k(n)/n² (for k ≥ 3, since k = 2 is trivial). The statement encodes the answer as an Option ℝ that equals some x iff the limit exists and equals x. That handles the 'if they exist' clause of [Er97f]. Faithful.
